rules.name: Spacing between inline elements should be explicit
FastAPI dependencies should use "Annotated" type hints
Ternary operators should not be nested
FastAPI routes should not specify redundant "response_model" parameters
Cognitive Complexity of functions should not be too high
Pytest fixtures without teardown should use return instead of yield
Regular expressions should not cause non-linear backtracking
String literals should not be duplicated
Functions, methods and lambdas should not have too many parameters
A subclass should not be in the same "except" statement as a parent class
Functions should be moved to the highest possible scope
Only one method invocation is expected when testing runtime exceptions
Pytest fixture and mark decorators should use consistent parentheses style
